blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧任务 A：八位加法⟦en⟧Task A: Eight-bit Addition

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧搜索结论⟦en⟧Search result
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧在测试的脉动进位结构和优化流程中，没有发现低于原始 37 门的候选。该结果不构成全局最优性证明。⟦en⟧No candidate below the original 37 gates was found within the tested ripple-carry structures and optimization flows. This result does not establish global optimality.

blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧一个半加器加七个五门全加器，完整验证 65,536 组输入。⟦en⟧One half adder followed by seven five-gate full adders, verified on all 65,536 inputs.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧原始设计已经正好对应 2 + 7 × 5 的标准脉动进位成本。我们利用全加器三输入对称性生成了 50 个不同的 37 门拓扑，再分别经过 SAT 窗口、重写与重映射；所有候选最终仍停在 37。⟦en⟧The baseline exactly matches the standard ripple cost of 2 + 7 × 5. We used full-adder input symmetry to generate 50 distinct 37-gate topologies and ran SAT windows, rewriting and remapping on each; every candidate remained at 37.

items: ⟦zh⟧标准五门全加器与本题的免费反相和 XOR/XNOR 等价计价规则兼容；测试中未发现更小的独立全加器实现。⟦en⟧The standard five-gate full adder is compatible with free complementation and equal XOR/XNOR cost; the tests did not find a smaller independent full-adder implementation.
⟦zh⟧保留同门数但结构不同的候选，可以检验后续优化结果是否依赖初始拓扑。⟦en⟧Retaining structurally distinct candidates with the same gate count tests whether subsequent optimization depends on the initial topology.
⟦zh⟧50 个测试拓扑均未低于 37 门；这一观察仅适用于已测试的拓扑和流程。⟦en⟧None of the 50 tested topologies fell below 37 gates; this observation applies only to the tested topologies and flows.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧任务 B：绝对差⟦en⟧Task B: Absolute Difference

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧优化思路⟦en⟧Optimization idea
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧B 的收益来自先做代数消除，再利用减法器与全加器之间的结构同构。⟦en⟧B improved first through algebraic cancellation, then through the structural equivalence between subtractors and full adders.

blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧总计减少 4 门，完整验证 16,384 组输入和 1,500 条训练数据。⟦en⟧Four gates saved, verified on all 16,384 inputs and 1,500 training rows.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧第一步：消掉两次异或⟦en⟧Step one: cancel two XORs

⟦zh⟧在原始的条件二补码阶段，最低输出位连续执行的两个 XOR 在代数上抵消。精确库映射识别出这一点，53 门直接降到 51 门。⟦en⟧In the original conditional two’s-complement stage, two consecutive XOR operations on the least-significant output cancel algebraically. Exact-library mapping exposed this and reduced 53 gates to 51.
⟦zh⟧第二步：把全减器看成全加器⟦en⟧Step two: reinterpret the full subtractor

⟦zh⟧全减器可写成输入为非 x、y 和借位的全加器；其进位就是下一位借位，而和位的补正好免费得到差位。基于全加器三输入对称性生成的 50 个种子，经八层 SAT 窗口后全部收敛到 49 门。⟦en⟧A full subtractor can be written as a full adder fed by complemented x, y and the borrow. Its carry is the next borrow, while the complemented sum yields the difference bit for free. Fifty symmetry-derived seeds all converged to 49 gates after eight-level SAT-window optimization.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧结果解释⟦en⟧Interpretation
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧在本任务的计分模型下，把全减器改写为带输入和输出极性的全加器形式，使优化结果由 51 门降到 49 门。该结果说明算术单元的表示方式会影响映射结果，但不说明该改写对其他门库或位宽同样有效。⟦en⟧Under this task’s cost model, rewriting the full subtractor as a full adder with input and output polarity reduced the mapped result from 51 to 49 gates. This shows that arithmetic-cell representation affects mapping in this instance; it does not establish the same benefit for other libraries or bit widths.
⟦zh⟧任务 C：六位乘法⟦en⟧Task C: Six-bit Multiplication

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧搜索范围⟦en⟧Search scope
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧C 的原始门数最高，所用搜索流程也最多。常规部分积压缩树在已测试流程中的最低结果为 166 门；更低结果分别来自大型多输出区域综合、公开构造复现和全局可达状态约束。⟦en⟧C has the largest initial gate count and received the broadest set of search procedures. The lowest result obtained from the tested conventional partial-product trees was 166 gates. Lower counts came from large multi-output region synthesis, reproduction of a published construction, and globally reachable-state constraints.

blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧减少 12 门；当前候选通过全部 4,096 组输入和 1,200 条训练数据。⟦en⟧Twelve gates saved; the current candidate passes all 4,096 inputs and all 1,200 training rows.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧阶段一：SAT 局部无关项优化，168 到 166⟦en⟧Phase I: SAT-derived local don’t-care optimization, 168 to 166

⟦zh⟧基线由 36 个部分积门、24 个五门全加器和 6 个两门半加器组成，恰好是 168 门。高强度 mfs2 使用 SAT 推导局部无关项，先得到 167，再用更大的六层窗口得到 166。之后生成 100 个随机压缩顺序种子，17 个也到达 166，但没有一个继续下降。⟦en⟧The baseline contains 36 partial-product gates, 24 five-gate full adders and 6 two-gate half adders, exactly 168 gates. High-effort mfs2 with SAT-derived local don’t-cares first reached 167, then 166 with a larger six-level window. One hundred randomized compressor-order seeds were generated; 17 also reached 166, but none went lower.

blocks.title: ⟦zh⟧166 门阶段的结构性观察⟦en⟧Structural observations at 166 gates

items: ⟦zh⟧基线中的全加器和半加器分别使用五门和两门；已完成的小型精确综合没有找到更低的独立实现。⟦en⟧Full and half adders use five and two gates, respectively; completed small exact-synthesis tests did not find cheaper independent implementations.
⟦zh⟧独立替换某个输出锥会复制原本与高位共享的中间进位。⟦en⟧Replacing a single output cone duplicates intermediate carries shared with higher bits.
⟦zh⟧局部切口把边界信号视为任意组合，会丢掉乘法器内部的可达性约束。⟦en⟧Local cuts treat boundary signals as arbitrary combinations and lose multiplier reachability constraints.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧阶段二：166 到 165，大型联合张量区域⟦en⟧Phase II: 166 to 165 through a large joint tensor region

⟦zh⟧小型扇出自由锥均未发现改进，于是我们转而把跨越多条乘法对角线的区域收缩成多输入、多输出布尔张量。一个 22 门、7 输入、5 输出的低位区域经过关系综合得到 21 门实现；128 个边界状态全部一致，嵌回全局后 4,096 组输入仍完全正确，于是 C 到达 165。⟦en⟧Small fanout-free cones yielded no improvement, so the search contracted regions spanning several multiplication diagonals into multi-input, multi-output Boolean tensors. Relation synthesis reduced one 22-gate, seven-input, five-output low-product region to 21 gates. All 128 boundary states matched, and the embedded circuit remained exact on all 4,096 inputs, producing the 165-gate result.
⟦zh⟧阶段三：采用不同乘法器构造，165 到 158⟦en⟧Phase III: replacing the multiplier construction, 165 to 158

⟦zh⟧对 165 门网络进行的后续局部和联合区域搜索没有产生更小结果。随后直接重建 Sergeev 给出的 158 门乘法器，其中包含 36 个部分积、6 个半加器、3 个普通全加器、1 个编码输入全加器、10 个改进双全加器，以及 11 个用于构造编码对的 XOR。165 到 158 对应整体构造替换，不能解释为在 165 门网络中删除了七个局部门。⟦en⟧Subsequent local and joint-region searches on the 165-gate network did not produce a smaller result. We then directly reconstructed Sergeev’s 158-gate multiplier, containing 36 partial products, 6 half adders, 3 ordinary full adders, 1 encoded-input full adder, 10 modified double full adders, and 11 XOR gates used to form encoded pairs. The change from 165 to 158 is a replacement of the complete construction, not the deletion of seven local gates from the 165-gate network.
⟦zh⟧阶段四：158 到 156，只在可达状态上成立⟦en⟧Phase IV: 158 to 156 using reachable states

⟦zh⟧全域语义重代入为每条内部线计算了覆盖全部 12 位输入的真值向量。它发现最高乘积位的四门扇出自由锥可以由两门替换。若把三个边界信号当作独立变量，该替换并不成立；但在真实乘法器的 4,096 个可达输入上，它完全等价。⟦en⟧Full-domain semantic resubstitution computed a truth vector over all twelve primary inputs for every internal wire. It discovered that the four-gate fanout-free cone driving the most significant product bit could be replaced by two gates. The identity is false if the three boundary signals are independent, yet it is exact on all 4,096 states reachable in the real multiplier.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧结论范围⟦en⟧Scope of the conclusion
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧158 是构造性上界，不是六位乘法的最优性证明。158 到 156 的结果表明，在本电路中，全局可达状态约束能够产生普通局部真值表未表示的简化机会。是否还存在其他此类区域尚未确定。⟦en⟧The 158 figure is a constructive upper bound, not an optimality proof for six-bit multiplication. The reduction from 158 to 156 shows that, in this circuit, globally reachable-state constraints can expose a simplification not represented by an ordinary local truth table. It remains unknown whether additional regions of this kind exist.

⟦zh⟧该流程的结果比手工压缩树多 10 门；推测通用位级映射没有保留全部共享结构。⟦en⟧This flow used ten more gates than the hand-structured compressor tree; the likely explanation is that generic bit-level mapping did not preserve all shared structure.
⟦zh⟧六位规模太小，重编码开销无法摊薄。⟦en⟧At six bits, recoding overhead cannot be amortized.
⟦zh⟧加减与重组成本超过少掉的部分积。⟦en⟧Addition, subtraction and recombination cost more than the saved partial products.
⟦zh⟧整数乘法在单变量切分下键维过大。⟦en⟧Integer multiplication has excessive bond dimension under one-variable cuts.
⟦zh⟧小型精确锥替换⟦en⟧Small exact cone replacement
⟦zh⟧已测试的独立锥没有更小实现；该结果不排除跨切口共享逻辑的改进。⟦en⟧The tested independent cones had no smaller implementation; this does not exclude improvements that share logic across a cut.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧任务 D：平方和⟦en⟧Task D: Sum of Squares

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧优化思路⟦en⟧Optimization idea
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧D 的改进来自多轮拓扑重写、随机种子筛选和四次联合区域替换。没有任何一次操作单独产生大于两门的减少。⟦en⟧D improved through repeated topology rewriting, randomized seed selection, and four joint-region replacements. No single operation reduced the count by more than two gates.

blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧减少 14 门，降幅 11.02%；完整验证 1,024 组输入和 400 条训练数据。⟦en⟧Fourteen gates saved, an 11.02% reduction; verified on all 1,024 inputs and 400 training rows.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧阶段一：确定性重写序列⟦en⟧Phase I: deterministic rewrite sequence

⟦zh⟧从平方专用的对角项与非对角项表示出发，resyn3、drwsat2 和高强度 mfs2 交替改变拓扑，形成 127、126、125、124、123、122 的连续轨迹。重复相同脚本很快稳定，因此后续搜索转向随机化结构。⟦en⟧Starting from a square-specific diagonal and off-diagonal representation, alternating resyn3, drwsat2 and high-effort mfs2 changed the topology along the sequence 127, 126, 125, 124, 123 and 122. Repeating the same scripts soon stabilized, motivating a move to randomized structures.
⟦zh⟧阶段二：拓扑岛避免早熟收敛⟦en⟧Phase II: topology islands avoid premature convergence

⟦zh⟧实验生成了 200 个精确平方和种子，并随机改变加权项和压缩器顺序。种子 003 经后续优化由 120 降到 119；另一个 120 门种子 012 则依次得到 118 和 117 门。在该样本中，初始门数相同的母体产生了不同的后续结果，因此搜索档案保留了同门数和少量增门但结构不同的候选。⟦en⟧The experiment generated 200 exact square-sum seeds with randomized weighted-term and compressor order. Subsequent optimization reduced seed 003 from 120 to 119 gates, while another 120-gate seed, 012, produced 118 and then 117 gates. Within this sample, equal-count parents produced different subsequent results, so the search archive retained structurally distinct candidates with equal or slightly larger counts.
⟦zh⟧阶段三：非连续张量窗口得到 115⟦en⟧Phase III: non-contiguous tensor windows reach 115

⟦zh⟧图张量搜索不要求区域在网表文本中连续，而是在超图中选取不会离开后重新进入的连通区域。综合器先为一个四输入、三输出的 10 门区域找到并验证了 9 门实现；重建图后，又为一个 8 门区域找到并验证了 7 门实现。两次替换均通过边界穷举和完整定义域验证，使门数由 117 降到 115。⟦en⟧Graph-tensor search does not require a region to be contiguous in the netlist text; it selects connected hypergraph regions that do not leave and later re-enter. The synthesizer first found and verified a nine-gate implementation of a four-input, three-output ten-gate region. After rebuilding the graph, it found and verified a seven-gate implementation of an eight-gate region. Both replacements passed boundary enumeration and full-domain verification, reducing the count from 117 to 115.
⟦zh⟧阶段四：26 门联合区域压到 25 门⟦en⟧Phase IV: a 26-gate joint region becomes 25

⟦zh⟧在 115 门网络中，一个 7 输入、5 输出、26 门的联合区域由 eSLIM 关系综合得到 25 门实现。全部 128 个边界赋值一致，嵌回后完整定义域仍精确，得到 114 门电路。⟦en⟧Inside the 115-gate network, eSLIM relation synthesis found a 25-gate realization for a seven-input, five-output, 26-gate joint region. All 128 boundary assignments matched and the embedded full circuit remained exact, producing a 114-gate circuit.
⟦zh⟧阶段五：27 门联合区域压到 26 门⟦en⟧Phase V: a 27-gate joint region becomes 26

⟦zh⟧在 114 门网络中，一个 8 输入、6 输出、27 门的凸联合区域由 eSLIM 得到 26 门实现。替换在全部 256 个边界赋值上等价；嵌回后，完整电路通过 1,024 组输入与 400 条训练数据验证，得到当前 113 门结果。对 113 门网络继续进行语义重代入、三个大型联合区域搜索和多种全局 ABC 重写，均未得到 112 门电路。该负结果仅适用于本轮测试范围，不构成最优性证明。⟦en⟧In the 114-gate network, eSLIM produced a 26-gate realization of an eight-input, six-output, 27-gate convex joint region. The replacement was equivalent on all 256 boundary assignments. After embedding, the complete circuit passed all 1,024 inputs and 400 training rows, producing the current 113-gate result. Follow-up semantic resubstitution, three large joint-region searches, and several whole-network ABC rewrites did not produce a 112-gate circuit. This negative result applies only to the tested search scope and is not an optimality proof.

blocks.title: ⟦zh⟧工具正确性问题及处理方式⟦en⟧Tool-correctness issue and mitigation

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧当前 ABC 版本导出非对称二输入门时会交换局部真值表的两个轴。第一次嵌入立刻被全局验证拒绝。修正扇入顺序后，先验证全部边界状态，再验证完整输入域。另一些 ABC 内部崩溃还会留下旧输出，因此每次运行必须使用唯一文件名，并同时检查退出码与文件时间。⟦en⟧The current ABC build swaps the two local truth-table axes when exporting asymmetric two-input gates. The first embedding was immediately rejected by global verification. After correcting fanin order, every replacement was checked on all boundary states and then on the full domain. Other ABC crashes can leave stale outputs, so every run must use a unique filename and check both exit status and file freshness.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧方法比较与适用范围⟦en⟧Method Comparison and Scope

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧适用边界⟦en⟧Scope
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧以下结论来自本问题、当前计分模型和已运行参数，不能直接外推到其他位宽、门库或优化目标。⟦en⟧The following conclusions are specific to this problem, cost model, and tested parameter settings; they should not be extrapolated directly to other bit widths, gate libraries, or objectives.

rows: ⟦zh⟧初始结构会影响后续门数；对 C，采用 Sergeev 构造得到 158 门，低于原 165 门结构。⟦en⟧The initial structure affects the resulting count; for C, Sergeev’s construction produced 158 gates, below the previous 165-gate structure.
⟦zh⟧在测试参数下，C 由 168 降到 166，D 由 123 降到 122。⟦en⟧Under the tested settings, C decreased from 168 to 166 and D from 123 to 122.
⟦zh⟧在 D 中产生了 117 门结果；相同门数的不同母体在后续流程中得到不同结果。⟦en⟧Produced the 117-gate D result; equal-count parents gave different outcomes under subsequent optimization.
⟦zh⟧在已接受的联合区域替换中，C 减少 1 门，D 累计减少 4 门。⟦en⟧Across the accepted joint-region replacements, C saved one gate and D saved four gates in total.
⟦zh⟧发现普通局部真值表看不到的 158 到 156。⟦en⟧Found the 158-to-156 reduction invisible to ordinary local truth tables.
⟦zh⟧作为每次替换、嵌入和正式更新的必要验收条件。⟦en⟧Used as a required acceptance condition for every replacement, embedding, and update of the retained circuit.

blocks.title: ⟦zh⟧本研究采用的工作准则⟦en⟧Practices used in this study
items: ⟦zh⟧实验优先保留算术结构；完整真值表 PLA 在 C 上产生 6,176 门，因此未用于后续候选生成。⟦en⟧The experiments retained arithmetic structure where possible. A complete truth-table PLA produced 6,176 gates for C and was therefore not used for subsequent candidate generation.

⟦zh⟧小型切口的精确综合结果仅用于判断该切口内是否找到更小实现，不用于推断整个电路最优。⟦en⟧Exact-synthesis results for small cuts were used only to determine whether a smaller implementation was found within that cut, not to infer whole-circuit optimality.
⟦zh⟧搜索档案保留同门数和少量增门但结构不同的拓扑，以支持非单调搜索。⟦en⟧The search archive retained structurally distinct topologies with equal or slightly larger counts to support non-monotone search.

⟦zh⟧只有按比赛门库重新映射后的门数用于比较；AIG 节点数等内部目标不直接作为最终得分。⟦en⟧Only the count after remapping to the challenge gate library was used for comparison; internal objectives such as AIG node count were not treated as the final score.

⟦zh⟧所有外部工具输出均经过独立解析和完整定义域验证，以检测崩溃残留、导出错误和功能不等价。⟦en⟧All external-tool outputs were independently parsed and verified over the complete domain to detect stale crash outputs, export errors, and functional inequivalence.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧当前保留的 C 和 D 电路分别为 156 门和 113 门，均经过完整定义域验证。这些结果给出了当前搜索得到的构造性上界；现有实验没有建立全局最优性。⟦en⟧The retained C and D circuits contain 156 and 113 gates, respectively, and both pass full-domain verification. They are constructive upper bounds obtained by the current search; the experiments do not establish global optimality.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧C 的候选上界 156⟦en⟧Candidate upper bound for C: 156
blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧公开文献核查中未发现低于 Sergeev 158 的同模型六位乘法结果；公开挑战电路中检查到 168 和 167。未发表、未索引或私人结果仍可能更低。⟦en⟧The literature audit found no same-model six-bit multiplier below Sergeev’s 158; inspected public challenge circuits scored 168 and 167. Unpublished, unindexed or private results may still be lower.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧D 的候选上界 113⟦en⟧Candidate upper bound for D: 113

sections.title: ⟦zh⟧第 2 页 · 随机噪声学习⟦en⟧Page 2 · Learning under Random Noise
sections.note: ⟦zh⟧学习器不知道隐藏函数是乘法，也不能读取第一页的 156 门电路。训练只使用在线生成的带噪样本；完整无噪定义域仅用于定期画曲线，不反馈训练。⟦en⟧The learner does not know that the hidden function is multiplication and cannot read the 156-gate circuit from page one. Training uses only online noisy samples; the complete clean domain is used solely for periodic plotting and never feeds back into training.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧突破：从随机噪声训练独立得到 156 门精确网络，与第一页参考同门数⟦en⟧Breakthrough: noisy training independently yields an exact 156-gate network, matching the page-one reference count
blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧两个随机初始化、两条独立噪声流分别在第 2,800 和 2,400 步学出同一个 36 项整数规则；通用压缩器先自动得到 158 门，再由只看学出网络全域语义指纹的盲搜索把最高输出的 4 门锥替换为 2 门。整个搜索未读取乘法公式、第一页电路、线号或重写模板；最终 156 门网络重新加载后在 4,096 / 4,096 个输入上逐门验证正确。⟦en⟧Two random initializations and independent noise streams learn the same 36-term integer rule at steps 2,800 and 2,400. A generic compressor first produces 158 gates, then a blind search using only full-domain fingerprints of the learned network replaces a four-gate cone at the highest output with two gates. The search reads neither the multiplication formula, page-one circuit, wire identities nor rewrite template; the final 156-gate network was reloaded and verified gate by gate on 4,096 / 4,096 inputs.

Upper right: integer projection shrinks 79 random-prior candidates to a stable 36 terms. Lower left: direct ANF and shared BDD are exact but require 5,046 and 3,343 gates. The same quadratic rule compiles to 168 gates with ordinary Wallace compression, 158 with generic MDFA dynamic programming that sees only column counts, and 156 after blind full-domain semantic resubstitution, matching the withheld page-one reference. Lower right: nonzero coefficients appear only between two automatically discovered input-bit groups; color encodes the binary exponent of each integer weight. This structure comes from training and is not a seeded formula.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧这里如何衡量结构不确定性⟦en⟧How structural uncertainty is measured here
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧浮点集成使用逐位分歧；离散规则改用“距离最近整数系数还有多远”。若最大取整残差接近 0.5，任一候选项都可能因少量新数据而改变整数值；若接近 0，规则具有大取整裕量。主实验和复跑最终残差分别为 0.000226 与 0.000041，同时非零项集合、整数系数和 158 门拓扑完全一致。这比只看 100% 准确率更严格地说明结构已经稳定。⟦en⟧The floating ensemble uses bitwise disagreement; the discrete rule instead measures distance to the nearest integer coefficient. A maximum rounding residual near 0.5 means that a small amount of new data can change at least one integer term, whereas a value near zero provides a large rounding margin. Final residuals are 0.000226 and 0.000041, while the nonzero set, integer coefficients and 158-gate topology agree exactly. This is stronger structural evidence than 100% accuracy alone.
⟦zh⟧最新加速：标签盲 D-optimal 实验设计⟦en⟧Newest acceleration: label-blind D-optimal experimental design

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧25% 噪声下平均只需 4,125 个样本，比均匀采样少 59.1 倍⟦en⟧At 25% noise, only 4,125 examples are needed on average—59.1x fewer than uniform sampling
blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧四个完全匹配的随机种子中，D-optimal 方法分别在第 35、40、40、50 批首次恢复全域 4,096 / 4,096；均匀采样分别需要第 2,355、2,355、2,370、2,675 批。每批仍为 100 个输入，每次观察仍重新生成独立 25% 位翻转。四次 D-optimal 训练都得到相同的 36 项整数规则，随后仍编译并验证为同一个 156 门网络。⟦en⟧Across four exactly matched seeds, D-optimal sampling first recovers all 4,096 inputs at batches 35, 40, 40 and 50; uniform sampling needs batches 2,355, 2,355, 2,370 and 2,675. Every batch still contains 100 inputs and every observation receives a new independent 25% bit-flip mask. All four D-optimal runs recover the same 36-term integer rule, which still compiles and verifies as the same 156-gate network.

blocks.title: ⟦zh⟧算法思想：用最少输入把通用假设空间“照亮”⟦en⟧Algorithm: illuminate the generic hypothesis space with the fewest inputs

pairs: ⟦zh⟧学习器预先知道什么⟦en⟧What the learner knows

⟦zh⟧只有 12 个输入位以及常数、一次项、两两 AND 构成的 79 维通用二次候选空间；不知道目标公式、正确系数、已有电路或任何干净标签。⟦en⟧Only the 12 input bits and a generic 79-dimensional quadratic candidate space consisting of a constant, linear terms and pairwise ANDs; no target formula, correct coefficients, existing circuit or clean labels.
⟦zh⟧输入如何选择⟦en⟧How inputs are selected

⟦zh⟧先把 0/1 特征改写成正负一效应编码，再对完整输入矩阵做带列主元 QR，选出 79 个满秩、高体积、条件数 8.776 的输入点；选择过程完全不读取输出。⟦en⟧Convert the binary features to effect coding, then apply column-pivoted QR to the full input matrix and select 79 full-rank, high-volume points with condition number 8.776; output values are never consulted.

⟦zh⟧随机打乱这 79 个点并循环，每次访问都向隐藏 oracle 请求一份新噪声标签；贝叶斯后验与整数投影保持不变。79 也是在该候选空间中唯一确定 79 个系数所需的理论最少独立方程数。⟦en⟧Shuffle and cycle through the 79 points, requesting a newly corrupted label from the hidden oracle on every visit; the Bayesian posterior and integer projection are unchanged. Seventy-nine is also the theoretical minimum number of independent equations for uniquely identifying 79 coefficients in this candidate space.

items.caption: ⟦zh⟧左：相同四个种子的全域整词准确率轨迹，D-optimal 曲线在约四千个样本处跃迁到 100%，均匀采样在约二十四万个样本处才跃迁。中：每个种子的配对首次全对样本数，纵轴为对数尺度。右：D-optimal 设计的效应基条件数固定为 8.776；随机 79 点设计条件数高得多，且两个实验在 100,000 样本后整词准确率仍只有 25.46% 和 29.69%。⟦en⟧Left: clean-domain word-accuracy traces for the same four seeds; D-optimal runs jump to 100% near four thousand examples, whereas uniform sampling jumps near 240 thousand. Middle: paired first-exact example counts on a logarithmic axis. Right: the effect-basis condition number is 8.776 for the D-optimal design; random 79-point designs are much worse conditioned, and two runs remain at only 25.46% and 29.69% word accuracy after 100,000 examples.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧边界：这是针对候选空间的主动实验设计，不是无假设的万能捷径⟦en⟧Boundary: this is hypothesis-class-specific experimental design, not an assumption-free shortcut
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧加速利用了“目标可能落在通用二次整数空间”这一建模假设，但没有利用乘法公式或目标输出。若真正规律含三次或更高阶项，79 点设计会欠定或在未观测输入上失败；因此每个冻结模型仍必须在独立的 4,096 个干净输入上做最终验证。下一步会把同样思想扩展为可增长候选空间：先用二次设计快速拟合，若验证残差呈现结构，再自动加入高阶项。⟦en⟧The acceleration uses the modeling assumption that the target may lie in a generic quadratic integer space, but it does not use the multiplication formula or target outputs. If the true rule contains cubic or higher-order terms, the 79-point design will be misspecified or fail on unseen inputs; every frozen model therefore still receives an independent 4,096-input clean verification. The next step is a growing hypothesis space: fit the quadratic design first, then add higher-order terms automatically if validation residuals remain structured.
⟦zh⟧高噪声复核：59 倍加速不是低噪声特例⟦en⟧High-noise confirmation: the 59x acceleration is not a low-noise exception

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧从 5% 到 45%，每一档都减少 55–72 倍样本；24 次训练全部精确⟦en⟧From 5% to 45%, every level uses 55–72x fewer examples; all 24 runs are exact
blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧把原来的十二次均匀采样实验与十二次 D-optimal 实验按噪声率和随机种子逐一配对。两组都只用新鲜带噪标签更新，最终全部恢复同一条 36 项整数规则。六档噪声的平均样本减少倍数为 55.0、60.0、55.6、57.1、72.4、61.4，说明实验设计提供的是跨噪声区间的稳定约六十倍增益，而不是 25% 单点调参。⟦en⟧The original twelve uniform runs and twelve D-optimal runs are paired one-for-one by noise rate and seed. Both groups update only from freshly corrupted labels, and every run ultimately recovers the same 36-term integer rule. Mean example reductions across the six noise levels are 55.0x, 60.0x, 55.6x, 57.1x, 72.4x and 61.4x, showing a stable roughly sixty-fold gain across the noise range rather than tuning to the 25% point.

blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧学习器只看到重复输入的带噪输出，不读取 oracle 的噪声设置。与已知真实噪声率的十二次实验逐一配对后，11 对在完全相同的批次首次全对，剩下一对的未知噪声训练反而早 5 批。首次全对时，估计噪声率与真实值的平均绝对误差为 0.001239，即 0.124 个百分点；最大误差为 0.003765，即 0.376 个百分点。⟦en⟧The learner sees only corrupted outputs for repeated inputs and never reads the oracle's noise setting. Paired one-for-one against twelve runs supplied with the true rate, 11 pairs first become exact at the identical batch, while the remaining unknown-noise run is five batches earlier. At first exact recovery, mean absolute noise-rate error is 0.001239, or 0.124 percentage points; the maximum is 0.003765, or 0.376 percentage points.

blocks.title: ⟦zh⟧为什么不用干净标签也能估计噪声⟦en⟧Why noise can be estimated without clean labels

pairs: ⟦zh⟧对同一个输入、同一个输出位取两次独立带噪标签，只统计两次是否不同；隐藏的干净位无论是 0 还是 1 都会在这个比较中消掉。⟦en⟧Take two independently corrupted labels for the same input and output bit and record only whether they differ; the hidden clean bit cancels from this comparison whether it is zero or one.

⟦zh⟧若单次翻转概率为 p，两次标签不同的概率 d 等于 2p(1−p)。累计 79 个设计点、12 个输出位上的所有异值对，先估计 d，再取小于 0.5 的解 p。⟦en⟧If the single-observation flip rate is p, the probability d that two labels disagree is 2p(1−p). Aggregate all disagreeing pairs over 79 design points and 12 output bits, estimate d, then choose the solution for p below 0.5.

⟦zh⟧每批重新计算 p，并用新的对数似然比重建所有已观察输入的干净位后验；整数投影、D-optimal 设计和最终全域验证均不改变。⟦en⟧After every batch, recompute p and rebuild clean-bit posteriors for all observed inputs using the new log-likelihood ratio; integer projection, D-optimal design and final full-domain verification remain unchanged.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧当前边界与下一步：从单一 p 扩展到逐位 p⟦en⟧Current boundary and next step: from one p to per-bit p
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧当前估计器假设 12 个输出位共享一个、对称且独立的翻转概率。真实硬件或数据流程可能让高位与低位噪声不同，也可能存在同一字内的相关翻转。下一轮先放宽为十二个逐位噪声率 p₀ 到 p₁₁，并用各位后验熵之和衡量一个输出字的不确定性；若逐位模型仍不足，再检验相关噪声。⟦en⟧The present estimator assumes that all 12 output bits share one symmetric, independent flip probability. Real hardware or data pipelines may give high and low bits different noise rates or introduce correlated flips within a word. The next round first relaxes this to twelve per-bit rates p₀ through p₁₁ and measures word uncertainty as the sum of per-bit posterior entropies; if that remains inadequate, correlated noise will be tested.

blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧两种模式都在每次出现样本时重新生成独立 25% 位噪声，没有固定噪声数据集。四种子配对实验显示：随机周期把每个输入的最少观察数固定到 78，并把最终取整残差中位数降低 3.55 倍，但平均首次全对反而晚 150 步。可能原因是有放回采样偶尔会给关键输入更多重复证据，从而更早越过整数边界；均衡覆盖则减少了最差输入和系数尾部风险。因此当前默认仍选更快的均匀采样，但在强调规则置信度时保留随机周期。完整哈希证据见 sampling_ablation_p25_summary.json。⟦en⟧Both modes regenerate independent 25% bit noise whenever an example appears; neither uses a fixed noisy dataset. Across four paired seeds, shuffled cycles fix the minimum observations per input at 78 and reduce the median final rounding residual by 3.55 times, yet delay mean first recovery by 150 steps. With-replacement sampling may occasionally give critical inputs extra repeated evidence and cross integer boundaries earlier, while balanced coverage reduces worst-input and coefficient-tail risk. Uniform sampling remains the speed default, with shuffled cycles retained when rule confidence matters. Complete hashed evidence is in sampling_ablation_p25_summary.json.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧这 2 门如何在盲搜索中消失⟦en⟧How blind search removes the final two gates
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧搜索器先从图结构计算十二个输出的最大无外部扇出锥；只有最高输出出现 4 门候选锥。它删除该锥后，把所有锥外输入线和内部线转换成 4,096 位语义指纹，枚举零门、一门和二门 AND、OR、XOR 表达式，自动找到“先 OR、后 AND”的二门替代。替换前后十二个输出的全域指纹完全相同，随后独立逐门模拟再次得到 4,096 / 4,096。156 仍是构造性上界，不是最优性证明。⟦en⟧The search first computes the maximum fanout-free cone of each output from graph structure; only the highest output has a four-gate candidate cone. After removing it, all external input and internal wires are converted into 4,096-bit semantic fingerprints. Zero-, one- and two-gate AND, OR and XOR expressions are enumerated, automatically finding an OR-then-AND replacement. All twelve full-domain output fingerprints remain identical, and independent gate simulation again gives 4,096 / 4,096. The 156 figure remains a constructive upper bound, not an optimality proof.

items.caption: ⟦zh⟧容量与学习率机制的统一比较。左上显示模型越小通常需要越多训练步；右上给出参数数与首次全对时间的前沿。左下固定宽度 48：按总步数预先设定的余弦退火在 6,000 步仅到 80.08%，恒定学习率虽达到 100% 却会再次出错；只用带噪训练损失触发冷却后，从第 4,900 步起 22 个检查点持续全对。右下显示已复现的最小精确学生为宽 36、13,872 参数；宽 32 在 12,000 步的 74.44% 只是一项负结果，不是理论下界。⟦en⟧Unified comparison of capacity and learning-rate mechanisms. The upper left shows that smaller students generally require more optimization; the upper right gives the parameter-versus-first-recovery frontier. At fixed width 48, the lower-left panel shows that fixed-horizon cosine annealing reaches only 80.08% by step 6,000, while a constant rate reaches 100% but later makes errors. Cooling triggered solely by noisy training loss stays exact for 22 checkpoints from step 4,900. The lower right identifies the smallest replicated exact student as width 36 with 13,872 parameters; width 32 at 74.44% after 12,000 steps is a negative result, not a theoretical lower bound.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧创新点：把“何时降学习率”交给带噪训练状态⟦en⟧Innovation: let noisy training state decide when to lower the learning rate
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧固定总步数的余弦计划会让小模型在尚未学会结构时过早冻结；恒定学习率又会在已经全对后把模型推离精确解。新的触发式计划只观察蒸馏损失的指数均值：先让小模型长期保持探索能力，达到预设置信区间后再冷却。这不是利用干净验证集调度，因此保留了训练与标准数据评测的隔离。⟦en⟧A fixed-horizon cosine schedule freezes small models before they learn the structure, whereas a constant learning rate can push an already exact model away from the solution. The triggered schedule watches only the distillation-loss EMA: it preserves exploration for as long as needed and cools only after reaching a preset confidence regime. It does not schedule from the clean validation domain, preserving the separation between training and standard-data evaluation.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧压缩仍不等于少门⟦en⟧Compression is still not a low-gate circuit
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧13,872 是浮点参数数，不是布尔门数；在线教师还保存 4,096 × 12 个后验状态，主动选择每步仍需评估 800 个候选。当前结果把可复现的精确学生缩小了，但尚未得到可与第一页 156 门电路直接比较的离散门图。下一循环将把稀疏化、离散化和门级验证直接放进目标函数。⟦en⟧The number 13,872 counts floating-point parameters, not Boolean gates. The online teacher still stores 4,096 × 12 posterior states and active selection evaluates 800 candidates per step. This round makes the replicated exact student much smaller, but does not yet produce a discrete gate graph comparable with the 156-gate circuit on page one. The next cycle puts sparsity, discretization and gate-level verification directly into the objective.

The result demonstrates rapid and repeatable recovery of the clean mapping, not a compact gate graph. The next stage must remove the teacher, prune parameters, discretize the model and verify the resulting gates.

items.caption: ⟦zh⟧早期基线在 25% 新鲜位翻转下的收敛曲线。四个面板依次显示整词准确率、完整干净定义域 loss、四个随机成员的位分歧，以及按二进制位权重计算的数值误差。横轴为训练步数，每个成员每步接收 100 个新鲜带噪样本；干净指标只记录、不训练。该图保留在后部作为新方法出现前的历史对照。⟦en⟧Convergence of the earlier baselines under fresh 25% bit flips. The panels show exact-word accuracy, complete clean-domain loss, disagreement among four random members and bit-significance-weighted numerical error. The horizontal axis is training steps, with 100 fresh noisy examples per member per step; clean metrics are recorded but never trained on. This figure is retained as the historical comparison preceding the new method.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧不确定性⟦en⟧Uncertainty
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧位不确定性衡量四个随机成员在十二个输出位上的总硬预测分歧，0 表示完全一致，最大值为 12；数值不确定性让高位分歧权重更大。主实验在首次全对时位分歧仍为 0.04395，说明集成投票已经正确但单成员尚不稳定；到第 3,000 步降为 0.000183。独立复跑最终为 0.006226。这里不把“集成输出全对”等同于“所有成员都全对”。⟦en⟧Bit uncertainty measures total hard-prediction disagreement across twelve output bits among four random members: zero means complete agreement and the maximum is twelve. At the main run's first exact checkpoint it is still 0.04395, showing that the vote is exact while individual members remain imperfect; it falls to 0.000183 by step 3,000. The independent replication ends at 0.006226. Exact ensemble output is not conflated with every member being exact.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧当前结论⟦en⟧Current conclusion
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧当前最强结论已经从“神经网络能否逼近”推进到“能否从随机噪声中学出与精确参考同门数的离散门图”：可以。79 项通用二次空间在两个独立随机种子上都收缩为相同的 36 项整数规则；不读取现有电路的通用压缩搜索先得到 158 门，再由盲全域语义重代入独立降到 156 门。浮点路线仍提供更快的首次全对和表示容量消融，但门级路线第一次把随机噪声训练、结构不确定性、稀疏规则、通用编译和实际门数闭合在同一条可复核证据链中。下一循环将从 156 门学习网络继续做更大切割的多门重综合，探索是否能低于当前构造性上界。⟦en⟧The strongest conclusion has advanced from whether a neural model can approximate the map to whether noisy data can yield a discrete gate graph matching the exact reference count: yes. In two independent random seeds, the generic 79-term quadratic space contracts to the same 36-term integer rule. A generic compressor search that does not read the existing circuit first produces 158 gates, and blind full-domain semantic resubstitution independently reduces it to 156. The floating route still provides faster first recovery and capacity ablations, but the gate route now closes a reproducible evidence chain from random-noise training and structural uncertainty through a sparse rule and generic compilation to an actual gate count. The next cycle applies larger-cut multi-gate resynthesis to the learned 156-gate network, exploring whether it can beat the current constructive upper bound.
